[tp-asciidoc-viewer%allow-script,label="tp-textfield"]
========
[script,type="tp/asciidoc"]
----
.Basic usage
======
[tp-textfield%clearable,label="Single line",placeholder="Type some text..."]
====
====
======

.Javascript API
======
[script,type="module"]
====
import "/components/textfield/textfield.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-textfield");
element1.setAttribute("label", "Single line");
element1.setAttribute("placeholder", "Type some text...");
element1.setAttribute("clearable", "");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
====
======

.Inline named field
======
Value: [tp-textfield,value="Ada",placeholder="Enter a value"]#identifier#
======

.Clearable search
======
[tp-textfield%clearable,label="Search",value="Garden"]
